description: Internal UDP data handler definitions for Zephyr OS network stack, including function prototypes for creating, finalizing, and processing UDP packets, as well as registering and unregistering UDP handlers.

methods.name: net_udp_create
methods.description: Creates a UDP packet in the provided net_pkt, setting the cursor after the IP header.

methods.name: net_udp_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the UDP packet by calculating length and checksum.

methods.name: net_udp_input
methods.description: Retrieves the UDP header from a network packet.

methods.name: net_udp_register
methods.description: Registers a callback for when a UDP packet is received.

methods.name: net_udp_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered UDP handler.
